TanStack Router route loader.description:
Load a route's data before its component renders; the abort signal is cancelled when the navigation is. Insert as a route option inside createFileRoute.

在路由组件渲染前加载数据，导航被取消时该 signal 一并中止；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。

TanStack Router loaderDeps.description:
Make a loader depend on search params. Without loaderDeps a loader is not re-run when only the search changes. Insert as route options inside createFileRoute.

让 loader 依赖 search 参数；不声明 loaderDeps 时，仅 search 变化不会重新执行 loader；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。

TanStack Router loader caching options.description:
Control how long a loader's result is reused and how long it is kept after the route unmounts. Insert as route options inside createFileRoute.

控制 loader 结果的复用时长，以及路由卸载后的保留时长；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。

TanStack Router beforeLoad.description:
Run before the loader and before any child route resolves; the right place to guard a route or to add to its context. Insert as a route option inside createFileRoute.

在 loader 与任何子路由解析之前执行，是守卫路由或补充 context 的位置；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。

TanStack Router useLoaderData.description:
Read this route's loader result inside its own component. Requires the Route exported by the route module.

在路由自身的组件中读取 loader 结果；需要该路由模块导出的 Route。

TanStack Router useLoaderDeps.description:
Read the dependencies the current loader run was keyed by. Requires the Route exported by the route module.

读取本次 loader 运行所依据的依赖项；需要该路由模块导出的 Route。

TanStack Router invalidate.description:
Re-run the loaders of every matched route, for instance after a mutation succeeds. Requires useRouter from @tanstack/react-router.

重新执行所有已匹配路由的 loader，例如在一次修改成功之后；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 useRouter。

TanStack Router deferred loader.description:
Await only what the first paint needs and hand the slower promise to the component. Insert as a route option inside createFileRoute.

只 await 首屏所需的数据，把较慢的 promise 直接交给组件；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。

TanStack Router Await deferred.description:
Render a promise returned by a loader once it settles. Requires Await from @tanstack/react-router and Suspense from react.

在 loader 返回的 promise 完成后渲染其结果；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 Await 与 react 的 Suspense。
